$comment: First-visit weight budgets, item 61. Reasoning and targets: docs/plans/2026-11-07-first-visit-weight-proposal.md.
Checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs after every build, and by e2e-sw/first-visit.spec.ts in a browser.
Sizes in KB (1024 bytes): JS, CSS, HTML and text at gzip level 9; images and fonts as stored.

limitKB is what the build may not exceed. Where it is above targetKB, it is the value measured in CI after the last landed step, rounded up to the next whole KB, plus 1 KB of headroom (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-08): a feature that has to live in the entry path may grow it by a few hundred bytes without a budget decision. Lower it to the new measurement plus 1 KB as each step lands; never raise it otherwise without a DECISIONS.md entry.
landingPageTotal: the browser spec counts every request until network idle; the build check can only count what index.html names, so it measures less.

landingJsBeforeLoad.measures: JS the page requests on / before load (gzip)

landingPageTotal.measures: Everything the page requests on / until network idle, excluding the precache (gzip)

appShellJs.measures: JS to render the unlocked library, Editor excluded (gzip). Today this is the entry path plus Sentry, which loads after load since step 2; Replay is not counted

precache.measures: Precache transfer: every URL in dist/sw.js, counted once

precacheDuplicateUrls.measures: URLs listed more than once in the precache manifest

precacheStartsAfterLoad.measures: The service worker registers, and the precache starts, after the load event. Build check: no registration code in the entry path. Browser check: e2e-sw/first-visit.spec.ts
